conclusions.text: The conditional-effect and Journal Officiel clauses are Articles 4/5 of Law 2021-012 and Articles 5/6 of Law 2023-012.
Exact conditional radio/television/posting and Journal Officiel publication dates remain unknown.
Law 2021-012 expressly transfers Namorona from Mananjary to Manakara; the pinned 2018 ADM3 record places its old code under Mananjary.
Post-transfer commune code/territory continuity and whether retained district polygons implement the transfer remain unresolved; broad district comparisons do not answer it.
The captured portal describes 119 districts but renders 114 rows and omits IDs 8 to 12; this is incomplete undated page evidence, not a complete roster.
The inherited decree record lists eight communes, while the operational notice lists four. The operational notice does not repeal the decree; the difference and boundaries remain unresolved.
MapAction is a secondary lead and does not prove legal continuity or polygon identity; the BNGRC predecessor remains unrestored.
